report.incidentSummary: On 2026-10-21 at 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC), job-scheduler triggered the morning payout batch PB-1021-AM for 2412 queued redemptions. None of the payouts were dispatched because payout-service immediately stalled waiting for database locks on the payout_instructions table. Concurrently, payout monitoring dashboards failed to load due to database query timeouts. The stall was caused by schema migration 0142 executed at 04:26 UTC, which ran a blocking DDL statement (ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '') that acquired an exclusive lock on the table and blocked concurrent RowExclusiveLock write and read operations.
report.rootCauseStatement: A long-running DDL schema migration (migration 0142, change CHG-48223) executed 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''', acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions four minutes before the scheduled 10:00 IST payout batch. This blocked payout-service transactions from updating payout instructions and locked up worker threads, preventing all 2412 redemption payouts from dispatching and causing dashboard queries to time out.

hypotheses.cause: Database schema migration 0142 executed an ALTER TABLE with NOT NULL DEFAULT on payout_instructions, acquiring an exclusive table lock that blocked payout-service batch processing and monitoring queries.
hypotheses.rationale: Database logs directly record 48 lock wait warnings between 04:31:56 UTC and 06:41:45 UTC showing processes waiting for RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions because they were blocked by process running 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''. Payout-service logs confirm the morning batch has been blocked on lock waits exceeding 7200 seconds with 0 of 2412 payouts sent.

hypotheses.cause: Upstream partner bank API failures or latency prevented bank-connector and payout-service from dispatching redemption payouts.
hypotheses.rationale: Bank-connector error rates remained steady around 0.50% and timeout rates remained nominal (0.44/min) across the window. Furthermore, payout-service never dispatched batch instructions to bank-connector because it remained completely stalled on the database lock.

facts.statement: At 2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z (09:56 IST), deploy-bot initiated database change CHG-48223 (schema migration 0142) executing 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref', which remained in status in_progress.
job-scheduler triggered morning payout batch payout-batch-am (run_c582287b) at 2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z (10:00 IST).
payout-service started batch PB-1021-AM at 2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z with 2412 redemptions queued.

Database logs recorded 48 lock wait warnings between 2026-10-21T04:31:56Z and 2026-10-21T06:41:45Z where processes were waiting for RowExclusiveLock on relation payout_instructions, blocked by process running 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''.

payout-service logged recurring ERROR messages every 30 minutes from 05:00:00Z to 06:30:00Z stating that lock wait on payout_instructions exceeded 1800s, 3600s, 5400s, and 7200s, with 0 of 2412 payouts sent.
bank-connector error_rate remained steady around 0.50% and timeout_count averaged 0.44/min with no abnormal error spikes between 04:00Z and 06:45Z.

inferences.statement: The DDL migration on payout_instructions acquired an exclusive table lock that prevented payout-service transactions from updating redemption instructions and locked database connections, causing payout metrics and dashboard queries to time out.
The payout batch stall was entirely internal to the database layer and was not caused by external partner bank API degradation.

assumptions.statement: The payout dashboard queries execute against the payout_instructions table or share the same database connection pool that was exhausted by blocked lock-waiting transactions.

recommendedActions.action: Terminate or cancel the blocking ALTER TABLE DDL transaction (migration 0142) on database to release the lock on payout_instructions.
recommendedActions.rationale: Releasing the exclusive lock will allow the waiting payout-service transactions and monitoring dashboard queries to proceed immediately.
recommendedActions.verification: Check database logs to verify absence of lock wait warnings on payout_instructions and confirm payout-service begins processing and dispatching batch PB-1021-AM.

recommendedActions.action: Restart or trigger payout-batch-am if payout-service aborted or failed the batch run once the lock is released.
recommendedActions.rationale: Ensures all 2412 queued redemption instructions are processed and submitted to bank-connector.
recommendedActions.verification: Verify payout-service logs show completion of PB-1021-AM with all 2412 redemptions processed and bank-connector receiving payout requests.

recommendedActions.action: Adopt non-blocking schema migration patterns (e.g. adding nullable columns first without default, backfilling in batches, and applying NOT NULL constraint separately) and avoid executing DDL migrations adjacent to peak batch windows.
recommendedActions.rationale: Running ALTER TABLE with NOT NULL DEFAULT rewrites the table or holds an exclusive lock under Postgres/relational engines, disrupting real-time batch operations.
recommendedActions.verification: Review deployment pipeline policies and migration linters to block migrations acquiring exclusive table locks during scheduled payout batch windows (10:00 and 14:00 IST).

report.justification: Although no critic reviewed this investigation, the finding is conclusive because database engine logs explicitly identify the exact blocking DDL transaction (migration 0142 running ALTER TABLE on payout_instructions) and payout-service logs corroborate an identical lock wait stall from the exact moment of batch initiation.

# Investigation report: Redemption payouts delayed

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** reporting agent

## Summary
On 2026-10-21 at 10:00 IST (04:30 UTC), job-scheduler triggered the morning payout batch PB-1021-AM for 2412 queued redemptions. None of the payouts were dispatched because payout-service immediately stalled waiting for database locks on the payout_instructions table. Concurrently, payout monitoring dashboards failed to load due to database query timeouts. The stall was caused by schema migration 0142 executed at 04:26 UTC, which ran a blocking DDL statement (ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT '') that acquired an exclusive lock on the table and blocked concurrent RowExclusiveLock write and read operations.

**Root cause:** A long-running DDL schema migration (migration 0142, change CHG-48223) executed 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''', acquiring an AccessExclusiveLock on payout_instructions four minutes before the scheduled 10:00 IST payout batch. This blocked payout-service transactions from updating payout instructions and locked up worker threads, preventing all 2412 redemption payouts from dispatching and causing dashboard queries to time out.

## Hypotheses
1. **Database schema migration 0142 executed an ALTER TABLE with NOT NULL DEFAULT on payout_instructions, acquiring an exclusive table lock that blocked payout-service batch processing and monitoring queries.** — `database`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_4, ev_5, ev_8, ev_9, ev_11, ev_12, ev_14] · Contradicting: none
   - Database logs directly record 48 lock wait warnings between 04:31:56 UTC and 06:41:45 UTC showing processes waiting for RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions because they were blocked by process running 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''. Payout-service logs confirm the morning batch has been blocked on lock waits exceeding 7200 seconds with 0 of 2412 payouts sent.
2. **Upstream partner bank API failures or latency prevented bank-connector and payout-service from dispatching redemption payouts.** — `bank-connector`, upstream_dependency_degradation, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_13] · Contradicting: [ev_2, ev_3, ev_4, ev_12, ev_14]
   - Bank-connector error rates remained steady around 0.50% and timeout rates remained nominal (0.44/min) across the window. Furthermore, payout-service never dispatched batch instructions to bank-connector because it remained completely stalled on the database lock.

## Facts
- At 2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z (09:56 IST), deploy-bot initiated database change CHG-48223 (schema migration 0142) executing 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref', which remained in status in_progress. [ev_5, ev_9]
- job-scheduler triggered morning payout batch payout-batch-am (run_c582287b) at 2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z (10:00 IST). [ev_1]
- payout-service started batch PB-1021-AM at 2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z with 2412 redemptions queued. [ev_4]
- Database logs recorded 48 lock wait warnings between 2026-10-21T04:31:56Z and 2026-10-21T06:41:45Z where processes were waiting for RowExclusiveLock on relation payout_instructions, blocked by process running 'ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''. [ev_14]
- payout-service logged recurring ERROR messages every 30 minutes from 05:00:00Z to 06:30:00Z stating that lock wait on payout_instructions exceeded 1800s, 3600s, 5400s, and 7200s, with 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_12]
- bank-connector error_rate remained steady around 0.50% and timeout_count averaged 0.44/min with no abnormal error spikes between 04:00Z and 06:45Z. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_13]

## Inferences
- The DDL migration on payout_instructions acquired an exclusive table lock that prevented payout-service transactions from updating redemption instructions and locked database connections, causing payout metrics and dashboard queries to time out. [ev_4, ev_12, ev_14]
- The payout batch stall was entirely internal to the database layer and was not caused by external partner bank API degradation. [ev_2, ev_3, ev_12, ev_13, ev_14]

## Assumptions
- The payout dashboard queries execute against the payout_instructions table or share the same database connection pool that was exhausted by blocked lock-waiting transactions.

## Timeline
- **2026-10-21T04:26:00.000Z (09:56 IST)** deploy-bot initiated change CHG-48223 (migration 0142): ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref on database. [ev_5, ev_9]
- **2026-10-21T04:30:00.000Z (10:00 IST)** job-scheduler triggered scheduled job payout-batch-am (run_c582287b). [ev_1]
- **2026-10-21T04:30:06.000Z (10:00:06 IST)** payout-service started batch PB-1021-AM with 2412 redemptions queued. [ev_4]
- **2026-10-21T04:31:56.146Z (10:01:56 IST)** Database logged first warning that processes waiting for RowExclusiveLock on payout_instructions are blocked by the ALTER TABLE migration. [ev_14]
- **2026-10-21T05:00:00.000Z (10:30 IST)** payout-service logged ERROR: lock wait exceeded 1800s; 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_12]
- **2026-10-21T05:30:00.000Z (11:00 IST)** payout-service logged ERROR: lock wait exceeded 3600s; 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_12]
- **2026-10-21T06:00:00.000Z (11:30 IST)** payout-service logged ERROR: lock wait exceeded 5400s; 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_12]
- **2026-10-21T06:30:00.000Z (12:00 IST)** payout-service logged ERROR: lock wait exceeded 7200s; 0 of 2412 payouts sent. [ev_12]

## Confidence
0.95: The database logs explicitly record the exact blocking query ('ALTER TABLE payout_instructions ADD COLUMN utr_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT') and the blocked table ('payout_instructions'), matching the migration started 4 minutes before batch execution and the specific lock wait errors logged by payout-service.
